meta.promptText: Which serum should I buy for acne-prone skin in India under ₹700?

response.text:
For acne-prone skin under ₹700, look for serums featuring **Salicylic Acid** (to clear pores and tackle active breakouts) or **Niacinamide** (to control oil and fade post-acne marks).[thedeconstruct.in](https://thedeconstruct.in/collections/anti-acne#:~:text=Deconstruct%20Salicylic%20Acid%20Oil%20Control%20Face%20Wash,wash%20choices%20for%20oily%20and%20combination%20skin.)

Here are top-rated options available in India within your budget:

This **lightweight, water-based serum** combines **2% BHA and 3% Niacinamide** to gently exfoliate, clear congested skin, and regulate sebum.

This **triple-active formula** blends **Salicylic Acid, Azelaic Acid, and Niacinamide** to treat active breakouts and reduce post-acne marks.

Packed with **5% Niacinamide, 2% Salicylic Acid, and 5% Azelaic Acid**, this budget pick **unclogs pores and calms inflammation**.

Infused with **Tea Tree Oil and Niacinamide**, this quick-absorbing serum **targets active acne and helps refine enlarged pores**.

Powered by **10% Niacinamide and Zinc PCA**, this fragrance-free option focuses on **fading dark spots and controlling excess oil**.

This **dermatologist-recommended serum** uses AHAs and BHAs to effectively **treat active acne, blemishes, and excessive sebum**.

### Summary Recommendation

* Choose the Pilgrim Salicylic Acid & Niacinamide Oil Control Serum or HYPHEN Acne Control Serum 2% Salicylic Acid if you want a balanced mix of breakout prevention and mark reduction.
* Choose the Pilgrim 10% Niacinamide Face Serum For Acne Marks if your active pimples have healed and you primarily want to clear up dark spots and hyperpigmentation.

If you like, I can help you choose a matching lightweight, non-comedogenic moisturizer to pair with your serum. Do you want me to do that?
